EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a normal carbonyl at 1710 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-011) and strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2924/3005 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), along with two C–O-type bands in the 1066 and 1222 cm⁻¹ region typical for an alkoxy group. The most diagnostic feature is the very strong band at 788 cm⁻¹, consistent with an O–O stretch of a peroxide; a secondary low-frequency band at 531 cm⁻¹ also fits an O–O bending mode (cf. peroxide references GFQ-055). Among candidates, only COOC=O (a peroxy formate) contains both an aldehyde C=O and an O–O bond, explaining the 1710, ~800, and ~530 cm⁻¹ features concurrently.
